Faq.q1: What happens if my flight is delayed?
Faq.a1: We monitor your flight and adjust the pickup time automatically. 60 minutes of waiting time are included.
Faq.a2: Payment is made conveniently in the car – cash or card. No online payment is required.
Faq.a3: Yes. The displayed price is a fixed price with no hidden costs.
Faq.a4: Depending on the vehicle, 4 to 16 passengers. Just choose the right vehicle.
